name: Digital Identity & Verification
vi: Định danh & Xác minh danh tính
items: The full national identity lifecycle: biometric enrollment, IDMS and ABIS de-duplication, ICAO chip cards, Mobile ID, national PKI, eSign and the national wallet.

National identity management system: the identity register and lifecycle - create, update, suspend and mark deceased - linked to ABIS, CRVS, card, Mobile ID and wallet issuance, with tokenized IDs and full audit.

National identity verification service for banks, telcos and agencies: demographic and biometric 1:1 checks against the register, consent-based eKYC, partner management, tokenized identifiers and per-transaction billing.
Check that ID cards and passports are genuine: chip reading, security features and data validation.

One platform for remote onboarding and identity verification: ID document and NFC chip reading, face match, passive liveness and deepfake defense, and device intelligence - combined into a single Trust Score, with an orchestration console, mobile and web SDKs and APIs.
Connect and verify customer identity through VNeID, Vietnam’s national electronic identity, with consent, data minimisation and audit logs built in.
Hold national ID, licenses and certificates on the phone and present them securely.
PKI-based identity and signing keys protected on the user’s phone.

name: Biometrics
items: Multimodal face and fingerprint identification for national ID, SIM registration and social programs: real-time 1:N de-duplication and 1:1 verification, scale-out matcher nodes, REST API and a MOSIP-compatible queue interface (MOSIP compliance testing in progress), on COTS hardware or cloud.
Capture and match four fingerprints with any smartphone camera - no scanner, no contact. SDKs for Android, iOS and web; 1:1 and 1:N; on-device or server.
Face capture with quality checks and fast matching for onboarding, login and identification, 1:1 and 1:N, with mobile and web SDKs.
Touchless palm recognition from a phone camera or kiosk for eGov services, border control and physical access.

Fixed enrollment stations and rugged mobile kits: ICAO face, ten-print or touchless fingerprints, document and NFC chip reading, signature; offline-first with encrypted sync to ABIS. Devices OEM-sourced from certified third-party manufacturers.
Guided registration software for stations and mobile kits: quality and liveness checks, on-the-spot duplicate alerts, operator controls, reports and multi-device support.

Open-source national IDMS on MOSIP, delivered as a complementary solution: SAVIS ABIS via the MOSIP ABIS API, enrollment devices, eSignet authentication, Inji and CryptoID credentials, PKI support and system integration. MOSIP compliance testing in progress.
Passive liveness, deepfake and video-injection detection with on-device AI, designed for ISO/IEC 30107-3 presentation-attack detection.

Identity in a digitally signed QR code: biometric and biographical data verified online or offline, unlocked by the holder's face or fingerprint, with selective sharing; also storable on a phone or smart card. Aligned with the ISO 22376 Visible Digital Seal standard (certification in progress).

name: Authentication & Access
vi: Xác thực & Quản lý truy cập
items: Passkeys and FIDO2 authentication that replace passwords and OTPs for citizens, customers and staff.
Six anti-fraud modules - SmartOTP, transaction signing and push, PKI token, Device Intelligence and Risk Engine - on one 1U appliance with a post-quantum HSM.
Mobile authenticator that activates remote signatures and approves transactions, with keys in the Secure Element or Secure Enclave.
Strong customer authentication on the customer’s phone: device-bound keys plus biometrics to approve logins and payments.
Next-generation soft-token OTP with device binding, transaction details on screen and protection against SIM swap.
Workforce and customer identity, single sign-on and access policies.
Issue, activate, renew and revoke smart cards, tokens and certificates from one console.
Hardware authenticators: TrustPass Key, Card, Sign Card and OTP / View Card.

items: USB cryptographic token that stores certificates and private keys for digital signing and secure login.
PIV-compatible smart card for employee and citizen ID: physical access, secure login and digital signatures on one card.
Cryptographic token with a built-in fingerprint sensor: the private key is used only after the owner’s fingerprint matches on the device.
A virtual smart card on the phone for identity, access, payments and signatures. Editions for Education, Citizen and Enterprise.

name: PKI Infrastructure
items: Root and subordinate CA hierarchy for a country’s public-key infrastructure and its trust services.
All-in-one public key infrastructure appliance: CA, RA, validation and HSM, ready in weeks.
On-premise time-stamping authority for enterprises and government systems.
One gateway that routes every signing and verification request to the right HSM, CA and policy.
High-volume server-side signing for systems and organizational seals.

items: Sign from any device while keys stay inside the HSM.
Trusted timestamp service that proves when a document was signed; combined with LTV for long-term validation.
Biometric eKYC (face and fingerprint) that verifies the person and issues a TrustCA certificate in the same flow.
Paperless workflows where every form and approval is signed, timestamped and archived with legal validity.
Certificate validation and registration authority services.

Prepare trust services and wallets for eIDAS 2.0: gap analysis, ETSI-based policies and conformity assessment preparation.

name: Fraud & App Protection

items: Detect identity fraud and risky sessions in real time.
Score the risk of every device in real time - emulators, rooted phones, remote-access tools, SIM swaps and device farms - to stop fraud before login or payment.
Recognize each device behind a login or payment to spot emulators, bots and account takeover.
Runtime self-protection for mobile apps against tampering, hooking, rooting and overlay attacks.
TrustShield+ protects banking and wallet apps (RASP, anti-tampering) and feeds threat signals into the transaction decision.

Network, application, endpoint and data security solutions designed, integrated and supported by SAVIS with global security partners.

Central lifecycle management for encryption keys across applications, databases and clouds: generate, rotate, back up and revoke under one policy.
Dedicated hardware security modules operated by SAVIS, consumed as a cloud service with no hardware to buy or run.

Post-quantum protected vault for keys, secrets and certificates that must stay confidential for decades.
Encrypted storage protected with post-quantum algorithms against harvest-now, decrypt-later attacks.
Discover and inventory every algorithm, key and certificate, then switch them by policy without rewriting applications - the foundation for post-quantum migration.
Crypto discovery, risk assessment and a phased roadmap to post-quantum cryptography.
Post-quantum cryptography toolkit for migration and hybrid deployment.
Quantum key distribution delivered with technology partners.

name: Data Security

Public service portal and integrated one-stop electronic system.
Integrates applications and services from central to local government - ministries, provinces and communes - and secures every API with the FAPI 2.0 Security Profile.

One mobile app for citizens to reach every public service, with digital ID and e-payments built in. One platform, many deployments: iBacNinh and other government apps run on the same SAVIS Digital Trust foundation. Winner of the ASOCIO Smart City Awards 2026 (awarded as SAVIS eGov SuperApp).
